passage: For cross-club collaborative events like the CSIT x SWITCH x RISC Board Games Night, ticket purchases are strictly restricted to students holding an active membership with at least one of the hosting societies. The Hello Rubric platform checks your student SSO profile at checkout to automatically validate your membership status before completing the transaction.

Official club memberships for RISC (RMIT Information Security Collective) are fully funded this semester and cost $0. Students can claim their free membership instantly by navigating to the official Hello Rubric portal link hosted in the @rmit.risc Instagram link-in-bio page.

All REECE (RMIT Electronic Engineering and Computing Club) merchandise pre-orders are final once the manufacturing collection window closes on Rubric. Refunds or size exchanges are not provided for change of mind or user ordering errors, unless an item arrives with a verified physical manufacturing defect.

When a high-demand MATRIX computing competition reaches maximum capacity on Rubric, a 'Join Waiting List' button appears. If a registered student releases their ticket or fails to clear their order invoice within the allocated 15-minute checkout window, the ticket is instantly pushed down to the next user in line.
